facts.title: gravity release during cleaning and preparation on HO-9403

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control DROP_ZONE_EXCLUSION: the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LIFTING_GEAR_INSPECTION: the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control LIFT_STUDY_APPROVAL: the preparation and approval of a lift study was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work on HO-9403 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically directing a lift and controlling the drop zone. HO-9403 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 20 April 2023 an incident occurred on HO-9403 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during cleaning and preparation, releasing gravity energy held as suspended load.
